title: George Griffin
description: Griffin declared the school board would not adopt two sections of the newly enacted Parents Bill of Rights. He declared two sections of the law were not supportive of “our” students’ welfare - to automatically notify parents of pronoun or name changes, and the prohibition of instruction about gender identity, sexual activity, and sexuality in grades K-4.”
body:
# George Griffin

# George Griffin (D)

# Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2025/12/griffin.jpg)

- At the Jan. 18, 2024 school board meeting, Griffin **[recommended not](https://proconian.com/district-opts-not-to-comply-with-north-carolina-parents-bill-of-rights/)** adopting parts of the state mandated Parents’ Bill of Rights, specifically regarding pronouns and gender identity.
- In an Oct. 2025 candidates forum, Griffin **[bragged](https://www.youtube.com/live/Ncf7KUryM-w?si=2h1RhT6MA6QOqXbg&t=3012)** about not adopting two items from the Parents’ Bill of Rights and claiming they were the only district to stand up to the General Assembly. Griffin claimed it was risky but they had to make a statement. Yet in Dec. 2025, Griffin **[told](https://www.wunc.org/education/2025-12-10/nc-house-oversight-committee-chapel-hill-carrboro-schools-parents-bill-of-rights)** a House Oversight committee, “I can say with 100% certainty that we, as a district, are complying with the law.”
